summary: Compose managed ticket and worktree pre-commit gates

delivery.outcome: The managed host hook preserves ticket lifecycle enforcement and always runs the repository-scoped worktree overlap guard before admitting an IN_PROGRESS or governance-only DONE commit.
nonGoals: Changing the overlap algorithm or its workspace discovery rules
Weakening ticket branch, staged status or DONE closure validation
Upgrading adopters before a corrected immutable standard release exists
Merging directly without exact-head trusted approval

architecture.decision: Separate the adopter payload from the hub's active hook, then centralize successful payload termination in a fail-closed worktree guard function. Declare its runtime files in the host contract so bootstrap derives and installs the complete executable closure from the package manifest instead of copying a hook that cannot run.
interfaceChanges: Successful managed pre-commit paths now require a passing repository-scoped worktree guard
The host contract declares the hook runtime files that bootstrap must install and activation must verify
The managed adopter hook has a dedicated source template instead of doubling as the hub's live hook
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; adopters remain on their previous immutable standard revision until an explicit adoption.

commands: set -e; for test in tests/*.test.sh; do bash $test; done
